findings: Non-blocking: Server-wide idle socket lifetime — idleTimeout 130 s applies to every route, not only uploads (confirmed). Acceptable at this scale; consider per-request server.timeout(req, ...) for upload only if connection pressure appears.

Non-blocking: Glob breadth of /api/v1/upload* — prefix match would also exempt future /api/v1/uploads... routes from the 20 s limit (confirmed). Consistent with the existing requireAuth mount; switch to /api/v1/upload + /api/v1/upload/* if a sibling route is added.
